 Advertisement Updated: 4:32 PM CST Nov 2, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Darby Bybee Chief Meteorologist Tracking overnight storm chances in Northwest Arkansas, River Valley
 Updated: 4:32 PM CST Nov 2, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Darby Bybee Chief Meteorologist FAYETTEVILLE, Ark. — Showers and storms likely arrive around midnight across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. A strong storm will be possible as this system moves through. Gusty winds, heavy rain, and an isolated tornado will be possible.
 Mostly dry conditions will prevail for much of Tuesday behind that system, though a spotty shower could redevelop during the afternoon and evening.
